name: coderax-workflow-engine
description: CoderaxAI's independent cloud-native intelligence, agent orchestration, durable workflow execution, model routing, and integration engine.

scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean && node --input-type=module -e "import {rmSync} from 'node:fs'; for (const dir of ['packages/sdk/dist', 'packages/contracts/dist']) rmSync(dir, {recursive:true, force:true})"
scripts.sdk:bundle: npm run clean && npm run build && node dist/scripts/sdk-bundle.js --write
scripts.sdk:check: npm run clean && npm run build && node dist/scripts/sdk-bundle.js --check
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test "dist/tests/**/*.test.js" && node dist/scripts/check-openapi.js && node dist/scripts/sdk-bundle.js --check
